1 FAQ - Ankh ANKH - GODS OF EGYPT   RULES CLARIFICATIONS     Q: Are Actions and Events in the game optional or  mandatory?  A:  Actions and Events in the game are mandatory. If you  can do it, you must do it. However, if a player is not able to  perform an Action for any reason (for example, if they don’t  have enough Followers to unlock an Ankh Power), they may  still move the corresponding Action marker with no effect. Here’s a more detailed list of how to resolve each Event and  Action: Events:   • Control Monument:  You must gain control of a Monument,  if possible. • Camel Caravan:  You must divide a region in two, if possible. • Conflict:  You must always resolve the entire Conflict.  Actions:   • Move Figures:  For each of your figures you must decide to  move it or not, up to 3 spaces (you can end up not moving any  figures). • Summon Figure:  If you have figures, you must summon 1  of your figures when selecting Summon (Pyramid Attuned is  optional, as stated in the power). • Gain Followers:  You can’t choose to gain less Followers than  you should from this action. • Unlock Ankh Power:  If you have an available Ankh Power and  enough Followers to unlock it, you must spend the Followers  and unlock it. Q: Do you need figures to gain Devotion from Monument  Majority? A:  Yes. You are always required to have figures in a region  to gain Devotion from your Monument Majorities. If all  your figures are killed by Plague of Locusts, you can’t gain  Devotion from Majorities.  Q: Can the player with the second most Monuments of  a type in a region gain Devotion from Majority if the  player with most Monuments has no figures there? A:  If a player has a Monument Majority in a region but doesn’t  have figures there, no other player can gain Devotion for that  type of Monument in that region (because only the player  with the actual Majority can gain Devotion and must be  present to gain it).  Q: Is the number of Follower tokens each player has  open information? A:  Yes. Followers are hidden during a Plague of Locusts bid,  but players are able to know the total number of Followers  any other player has at all times. Q: In which order do players gain Devotion during a  Battle? A:  This is the order for gaining Devotion during a Battle: 1-Monument Majority (+ Bountiful Ankh Power) 2-Winner of the Battle (+ Drought Card + Glorious Ankh  Power + Bountiful Ankh Power) 3-Magnanimous Ankh Power (+ Bountiful Ankh Power) 4-Miracle Card (+ Bountiful Ankh Power) 5-Worshipful Ankh Power (+ Bountiful Ankh Power) Each one of those is a separate step and all Devotion  gained in a step by a single player is granted at the same  time. Bountiful adds Devotion to each applicable step if you  are still in Red when that step is resolved. (e.g., If you have  Bountiful in Red, and would gain from Pyramid and Obelisk  majority, you gain 3 Devotion in step 1.) If multiple players would gain Devotion in the same step,  they gain in reverse Devotion order. Q: Can I sacrifice 2 Followers for Worshipful multiple  times in the same Battle? A:  No. You can only use Worshipful once per Battle. Q: Can a player who lost all their figures win a Battle  with only their strength bonuses? A:  No, a player with no figures ignores any bonuses and has  0 strength. Q: If during a Battle all players lose their figures, can a  player holding the tiebreaker token activate it to win  the Battle and gain 1 Devotion? A:  No. A player needs figures to win a Battle.   MERGING GODS     Q: After the Merge, do players change the seating  order to play turns in sequence? A:  No, the turn order never changes. In some games the  merged players take turns in sequence, in others they don’t. FAQ - 1.0 

2 Ankh - FAQ Q: When Merging, can players choose any mix of  Guardians from both gods?  A:  No. The higher-merging god MUST keep all their Guardians  and may gain control of the lower-merging god’s Guardians  as long as they have spare color bases. They cannot swap  their Guardians for ones from the lower-merging god. Q: When Merging, do Guardians that were kept from  the lower-merging god stay on the board? A:  The higher-merging god simply replaces the color bases  from the chosen Guardians, and they stay where they are. If  they were on the board, they stay there, if they were in the  pool, they stay in the pool. Q: Since both Merged players have a dashboard with  the same set of Ankh powers, can they use their Ankh  powers twice? A:  No. The Merged players have only 1 instance of each Ankh  Power even though they keep track of them separately. For  all purposes, the Merged God is considered a single entity.  Any effects that refer to gods or players see the Merged God  as a single player/god.   BATTLE CARDS     Plague of Locusts Q: What happens when multiple players play the Plague  of Locusts card in the same Battle? A:  If multiple Plague of Locusts cards are played in a Battle,  that many bids are resolved in sequence. Players with at  least 1 figure in the region participate in the resolution of all  bids, even if all their figures were killed in one of the previous  bids. (Being in the region at the beginning of the phase is  enough to qualify for all Plague of Locusts resolutions.)   GODS AND GUARDIANS     Anubis Q: Can Anubis trap a Warrior killed in a Battle he is not  participating? A:  Yes. Anubis can trap a Warrior any time Warriors are  killed, even outside of a Battle. Apep Q: Can Apep move into Water spaces? A:  No. It can finish a movement only in non-Water spaces.  Note, however, that it may be summoned in ANY Water space,  it doesn’t need to be adjacent to your figures or monuments. Cat-Mummy Q: If the 2 players controlling the Merged God would  lose Devotion because a Cat-Mummy died, how much  Devotion do they lose? A:  The Merged God is considered a single god/player for  effects. So, in this case they would lose only 1 Devotion. Giant Scorpion Q: What does the phrase “Those spaces must be 1 space  away from the Scorpion and 1 space away from each  other” mean? A:  A Space is 1 Space away from another if they share a Hex  border, which also means that with 1 movement, you could  go from one space to the other. In Ankh, this is different from  being adjacent: Two spaces are adjacent if they are 1 space  away from each other AND in the same region. Since the Giant Scorpion is a physical miniature, it is always  pointing at 2 spaces that are 1 space away from it. But they  are not necessarily adjacent to it. If there’s a river or camel  between the Scorpion and the Monument, the Monument is  not adjacent, and thus cannot be destroyed. Mummy Q: If a Mummy is killed multiple times in the same  Battle, how many times does it count for the Miracle  card? A:  Each time the Mummy dies, it is considered a different  instance of a figure being killed. So, if a Mummy is killed  twice in the same battle, you would gain 2 Devotion from  Miracle, 1 from each time the Mummy was killed. Satet Q: Can Satet move Sobek into a Water space? A:  You may only move enemy figures into a Water space if  the figure is allowed to occupy it (e.g., you cannot move Apep  into a Water space, but you can move Ammit or Sobek).   SCENARIOS     The Great Rebuilding  Q: NOTE 1 says that if a player would resolve a Control  Monument event, but has no Monument tokens  left in their pool, instead of gaining control of an  adjacent neutral Monument, they destroy it and gain  the 3 Followers. But NOTE 2 says that when neutral  Monuments are destroyed, Followers are discarded.  What is the correct way to resolve this? A:  NOTE 2 describes what happens when OTHER effects, like  the one from Giant Scorpion, destroy a Monument. In the  case a Monument is destroyed because the player has no  tokens left, the player gains the Followers instead of them  being discarded. Twilight Over the New Kingdom Q: What happens first, Worshipful or the Devotion loss  from losing a Battle while controlling a City? A:  Worshipful triggers before the player controlling the City  loses Devotion. 

3 FAQ - Ankh PANTHEON Bastet Q: Are Bastet Cats tokens or figures? A:  Bastet Cats are tokens, not figures, which means they are  not removed by Plague of Locusts and that Bastet needs at  least 1 figure in the region during Battle Resolution to add  the Cat’s strength.  Set Q: If an Anubis Warrior controlled by Set is killed, can  Anubis trap it? A:  Anubis can only keep Warriors from other players.  Although the Warrior is considered as belonging to Set when  killed (which is relevant for Miracle), Anubis cannot keep  that Warrior trapped. The Warrior immediately returns to  Anubis’ pool. Q: What happens if Set is controlling one of Osiris’  figures that is on an Underworld token, since enemy  figures cannot occupy an Underworld space? A:  The figure stays in the token but still belongs to Set. Figures  can’t be placed there, either by summon or movement but  stay if already there. PHARAOH Q: Does resolving the War Room effect count as  building a Monument? A:  No. You are not building the Monument, you are merely  replacing it. Q: Can Hathor summon a Priest to the Palace dashboard  instead of a figure on the board? A:  No. Hathor’s ability can only be used to summon figures  to the main board. GUARDIANS SET Am-Heh Q: Can you choose to end Am-Heh’s move in the same  space it started and still activate the ability? A:  Yes. Ammit Q: Can you choose to end Ammit’s move in the same  space it started and still activate the ability? A:  Yes. Shezmu Q: What happens if 2 Shezmus are in the same region? A:  This is very rare since a Shezmu cannot enter or be  summoned in an enemy Shezmu’s region. But in the rare  cases when it happens, ALL Guardians in the region lose  their strength and abilities (including both Shezmus). TOMB OF WONDERS Babi  Q: Can Babi be destroyed by the Giant Scorpion?  A:  This is a rare interaction, since Babi and Giant Scorpion  are both Level 3 Guardians. But Babi is not a Monument, so  he can’t be destroyed by the Giant Scorpion.  Petsuchos Q: Does Petsuchos stay on the board if it was controlled  by one of the Merged Gods?  A:  Petsuchos is resolved after the Merging, so if it was  controlled by one of the Merged Gods, it stays on the board. Q: If Ra makes Petsuchos Radiant and loses control of  it, removing it from the board, what happens to the  Radiant token? A:  When Radiant Petsuchos is removed from the board, the  Radiant token is returned to Ra. Ptah Q: What happens if Anubis has an Exalted Follower and  Ptah is forgotten? A:  If Ptah is forgotten, any Exalted Followers in Anubis’  possession stay with him and can still be spent as 2 Followers.
